Welcome to the tutorial for the hands-on workshop at the [first in-person Swedish Metabarcoding Network (SMN) meeting](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"}, Uppsala, 8–9 December 2026! It shows how eDNA/metabarcoding data published through the [Swedish Biodiversity Data Infrastructure (SBDI)](https://biodiversitydata.se/){target="_blank"} can be downloaded from the ASV portal and explored in R.

You choose one of two alternative tracks:

- **Track A, insects:** COI metabarcoding data of arthropods across Swedish habitat types, from the [Insect Biome Atlas](https://www.insectbiomeatlas.org/){target="_blank"}
- **Track B, marine plankton:** 16S metabarcoding data of bacterioplankton along the salinity gradient of the Baltic Sea

## Time and place

Wednesday 9 December 2026, 09:00–12:00<br>
Evolutionsbiologiskt centrum (EBC), Norbyvägen 14, Uppsala

[Start the tutorial →](tutorial.qmd)

Times may still change. See the [meeting page](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"} for the full programme.
